MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE BRIEF AS AMICUS CURIAE
Amici Curiae Texas Values and State Representative Jeff Leach respectfully moves 
for leave to file the accompanying brief in support of Respondents.
Texas Values is a nonprofit organization dedicated to protecting women, minors, 
parental rights, and unborn life through litigation, public policy advocacy, and legal 
education. Amici has substantial experience addressing state laws governing 
chemical-abortion distribution, interstate circumvention schemes, and protections 
against coercive and concealed abortions involving vulnerable minors.
Texas State Representative Jeff Leach is a member of the Texas Legislature serving 
Texas House District 67 and is the House authors of Texas House Bill 7, enacted 
during the 89th Legislature, Second Called Session (2025). Representative Leach 
seeks to preserve the sovereign authority of the State of Texas to safeguard women, 
minors, and unborn life from unlawful and harmful chemical-abortion distribution 
systems operating beyond traditional state enforcement mechanisms.
The accompanying brief offers a distinct perspective concerning the sovereign 
interests of States in preventing anonymous mail-order distribution of abortioninducing drugs, particularly where such distribution systems facilitate coercion, 
concealment, and circumvention of state abortion prohibitions involving minors.
_________________________________________
------------
NOS. 25A1207, 25A1208
Supreme Court of the United States
 DANCO LABORATORIES, L.L.C., et al.
 Applicants
 v.
 STATE OF LOUISIANA, et al.,
 Respondents.

Due to the expedited nature of these proceedings, amici were unable to obtain 
consent from all parties before filing. Amici respectfully submits that the 
accompanying brief may assist the Court in evaluating the important federalism, 
sovereignty, and public-safety interests implicated by the application.
For these reasons, amici respectfully request that this Court grant leave to file the 
accompanying brief.
Respectfully submitted,
